about_the_game:
About:

In this space themed top down maze runner you play as Skippy who's racing to reach each maze's exit as fast as possible.

Watch out for enemies, traps, black holes and other dangers.

Unlock skills during your playthrough and use them tactically to achieve the best possible time for each level.

Compare your time against the game's times as well as Steam friends and global leaderboards.

Skills:

Select 3 out of 16 skills before you start a level. Choose the optimal skill combination for each level and game mode.

Examples:

  • Active Sensor Pulse: Send out an Active Sensor Pulse to reveal tactical information about enemies and your surrounding. Also shows an indicator pointing to the level exit.

  • Freeze Nova: Freeze all enemies within range for a short time. While frozen, enemies can not harm you.

  • Tactical Beacon: Deploy a tactical beacon at your current location. While the beacon is active, use the skill again to teleport back to your beacon. The Tac Beacon is great to prevent backtracking or to create fast escape routes.

  • Stealth Field: Engage a Stealth Field that renders you invisible for enemy sensors. Creating spacetime rifts (dashing) or using any skills will break the Stealth Field!

  • Losing Containment: Channel and release a ginormous amount of energy, killing everything in a huge blast radius.

  • Kinetic Impactors: Crash 5 asteroids at relativistic speed into the 5 enemies closest to you, instantly killing each enemy hit.

  • Skills will be unlocked during a playthrough. Some of which with the potential to make your playthrough a lot safer, others with the potential to achieve faster times on the leaderboards.

Levels:

  • One overworld connecting 6 sectors with 6 levels each

  • Unlock new sectors by reaching all exits of the previous sector

  • Each sector introduces new mechanics and skills

Gameplay modes:

3 modes for different player types: Default, Relaxed and Hardcore.

  • In default mode you'll race the exit to compete against the game's tiers as well as global and friends leaderboards.

  • Hardcore mode offers an additional challenge of perma-death. Beat the game with one life only!

  • Relaxed mode removes the timer, tiers and leaderboards. Take as much time as you want for each level to have a chilled experience and still see all of the game's content.

Competition:

  • Each level and mode combination (except "relaxed mode") has its own leaderboard

  • Thus you can compete for each level's best time individually for Default and Hardcore mode
